_doc: Exclusions for scripts/check-merge-clobber.mjs. Use this file for deliberate reverts/break-proofs whose commit message cannot carry the [no-clobber-check] marker (e.g. already-landed history). commits: sha prefix (>=7 chars) -> reason, skips that commit in both checks. paths: glob -> reason, always ignores matching paths. reversions: suppress a specific A->B->A blob reversion; path is a glob, by is the reverting commit's sha prefix.

commits.b9da768: Deliberately superseded within the same task: the completion rebase found mainline had gained its own review-hardened, CI-proven divide-fallback implementation via parallel work, so this commit's duplicate code was dropped in conflict resolution (all overlapping files verified byte-identical to mainline, harness green post-rebase), and its kit-doc expectation lines were rewritten by the later handoff repackage commit to the measured 2026-10-01 physical-Pixel field result.
commits.559bf4c: Deliberate add-then-remove scratch pair with 0536cd8 (.push-files.txt push scratch); nothing was meant to survive to HEAD.
commits.8a09f04: Deliberately superseded by 47044d0 in the same task: code review required the watchdog to stop referencing the push-capable PAT, so 47044d0 rewrote the rotation note and auth comment lines 8a09f04 had added.
commits.1413253: Accidental rebase damage: this completion commit restored pre-28498ee blobs for the cas-config files after 28498ee (responder-seeding removal) landed mid-completion. Fully superseded by 6a077ff's deliberate repair — HEAD's cas-config.ts and cas-delivery-config.ts are diff-empty against 28498ee, and cas-config.test.ts is a verified reconstruction (28498ee's own blob failed tsc with TS1128); contract suite 255/255 green at HEAD.
commits.6a077ff: Deliberate repair of 1413253's accidental discard of 28498ee: restores 28498ee's cas-config.ts and cas-delivery-config.ts blobs verbatim and reconstructs cas-config.test.ts (28498ee's blob was itself rebase-mangled garbage — stray for-loops, undefined identifiers) with the no-seed guard test; non-incremental typecheck clean, contract suite 255/255 green.
commits.d3dffd6: Deliberately superseded by a7d3299 within the same task: CI run 36705662402's viewport digests showed the gentle-drag scroll still flung past the Send button, so a7d3299 replaced that block with the sweep-with-reversal loop. Iteration within one task, not a clobber of concurrent work. (SHAs refer to the rebased history; pre-rebase equivalents were 22e84b4/6029abc.)
